The reference matches well. Both images show the same hallmark feature: dense, small, black circular/oval tar-like spots (stromata of *Phyllachora maydis*) scattered across the corn leaf surface. The test image is at a later stage with more leaf senescence (grayish-green, tan patches), but the spot morphology is identical.
